messages.subject: validate with a loop
parts:
Hello dear Shiny Community.
I am trying to create an app to perform Multiple Factorial Analysis.
I want my user to give a name to each group he creates. The number of groups is in values()$NB and the name of the group is written by the user with a text Input which id is nameG1, nameG2, ... , nameGn. So, I have the following loop to create the error message :
 

for ( i in 1:values()$NB){
        validate(
          need(input$nameG[i]!="Enter text...","Please give a name to Group ")
        )
      }

But unfortunately, it is not working.
Can you help me please ?

Thx !!

messages.author: 55771919c42cb6a1
messages.subject: Re: validate with a loop
parts:
I think you need to do something like:
  input[[paste0('nameG', i)]]
instead of:
  input$nameG[i]

-Winston
